jurisdictions.name: Dixon
jurisdictions.notes: Building Division page says to call (707) 678-7005, option 2, for permit applications or general questions; the same number is the 24-hour inspection request line. The Permits page (https://www.cityofdixonca.gov/permits) lists the Building Division as (707) 678-7000 ext. 1789. Portal is Dixon Civic Access (Tyler EnerGov); all permits must be submitted there since 2025-12-01. No standalone ADU page; adu_page_url is the 'ADU Information' section of the forms page, which links PDFs (ADU flyer, pre-approved ADU program, AB 2234 and AB 2533 handouts).

jurisdictions.name: Rio Vista
jurisdictions.notes: Building page was read once (HTTP 200) on 2026-09-30; later requests to riovistacity.com, including the status checks for building_dept_url and adu_page_url, returned HTTP 403 (bot protection). (707) 374-6451 is the City Hall main line; the Building page lists building staff at ext. 1122 (Public Works Program Manager) and ext. 1104 (Administrative Assistant) and no separate division number. Applications can also be emailed to buildingpermits@ci.rio-vista.ca.us. adu_page_url is the 'Pre-Approved ADU Plans' page linked from the Building page; its content was not read.

jurisdictions.name: Vallejo
jurisdictions.notes: Portal is eTRAKiT; new users register at https://vall-trk.aspgov.com/eTRAKiT/publicUserAccount.aspx?action=npa. Inspection IVR (707) 648-4384. adu_page_url is a PDF: the Planning Division page's 'Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)' link points to this file (ADU/JADU guide); the older HTML ADU page URL in search results returns 404. www.vallejo.gov also exists but serves a Cloudflare challenge, so cityofvallejo.net was used.

jurisdictions.name: Solano County (unincorporated)
jurisdictions.notes: Department of Resource Management, Building & Safety Services, 675 Texas St., Suite 5500, Fairfield; building@solanocounty.gov. parcel_lookup_url is the county Tax Parcel Viewer (Solano County GIS). The county's Look Up Zoning & FAQ page (https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/resource-management/planning-services/development-planning/look-zoning-faq) says: 'To find out if your property is located in the unincorporated area, visit the Tax Parcel Viewer and enter the Assessor's Parcel Number (APN) or Address.' solanocounty.gov robots.txt disallows *.pdf, *.aspx and /sites/, so no files on those paths were read.
